mapper.select: SELECT Id as id, name, parent_id, level, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, remark, tenant_id FROM efvs_doc_directory ORDER BY parent_id, Id
SELECT id, level -- 仅需查询层级用于计算子目录层级 FROM efvs_doc_directory WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO efvs_doc_directory ( name, parent_id, level, remark, creator, updater, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{parentId}, #{level}, #{remark}, #{creator}, #{updater}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, parent_id, level, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, remark, tenant_id FROM efvs_doc_directory WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0
